brief:
An investigation into an Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital found that Israel probably committed war crimes in a double-tap attack that killed 20 people, including journalists and medics, Middle East Eye reported. The strike involved two successive bombardments of the same target, a tactic typically designed to kill rescuers who respond to the initial blast.

UK Members of Parliament urged their government to hold Israel accountable following the attack. The hospital strike claimed the lives of medical personnel and journalists who were working at the facility when the bombardment occurred.
